UNEXPECTED.then: read stderr; it is a bug in the script: report it, do not loop

USAGE.then: pass the missing argument and run it again

INVALID_BRANCH.then: rename the branch to feat/, fix/ or ops/ + a kebab-case name

FOLDER_EXISTS.then: work in the existing folder, or retire it first if its PR is merged

GIT_FAILED.then: read stderr, fix the git problem (network, auth, state) and run it again

INSTALL_FAILED.then: folder and branch exist: run npm ci inside the folder, do not run tarea again

NOT_FOUND.then: there is nothing to retire: check the name

DETACHED_HEAD.then: put the folder on its branch by hand; retire refuses a folder with no branch

INSIDE_FOLDER.then: run it again from another folder (the main one)

UNSAVED_CHANGES.then: commit and push the changes, or discard them on purpose, then run it again

NOT_MERGED.then: wait for GitHub to merge the PR (tests and revisor green), then run it again

GH_FAILED.then: GitHub did not answer: run it again; if it keeps failing, check the App token

NODE_MODULES_SHARED.then: retire the other folder first, or remove its node_modules junction

DONE_LINT_FAILED.then: fix what lint reports and run done again

DONE_TESTS_FAILED.then: fix the failing test or the code it checks and run done again

LESSON_FAULTS.then: fix each fault code printed in the output and run lessons again
